title: Cognitive Load-Aware VR Game
description: Currently developing an interactive learning environment in Unity and C# for VR designed to measure cognitive load through integrated eye-tracking and body-tracking hardware. Spearheading a research initiative to create a novel dataset on cognitive load in neurodiverse learners, with the goal of analyzing the data and co-authoring a research paper for publication.
longDescription: This research focuses on developing a Cognitive Load-Aware VR Game. By integrating eye-tracking and body-tracking hardware, we aim to measure cognitive load in real-time. The project involves creating a novel dataset on cognitive load in neurodiverse learners. The ultimate goal is to analyze this data to better understand learning processes and to co-author a research paper detailing these findings.

title: Predictive Modeling in Educational VR
description: Co-authored and submitted a research paper on applying machine learning to predict student behavior in educational Virtual Reality (VR) environments. Developed and evaluated a suite of predictive models, achieving a 97.5% R2 in a Bayesian Ridge regression model for engagement scores and 84.9% accuracy in a Multinomial Regression classifier for identifying student engagement levels.
longDescription: In this project, we applied machine learning techniques to predict student behavior within educational Virtual Reality environments. We developed and evaluated a suite of predictive models. Key achievements include achieving a 97.5% R2 in a Bayesian Ridge regression model for engagement scores and 84.9% accuracy in a Multinomial Regression classifier for identifying student engagement levels.

title: VR MRI Project
description: Executed an end-to-end medical imaging pipeline by preprocessing MRI datasets with FSL for image segmentation, training a deep learning model with nnU-Net, and developing a real-time 3D rendering interface in Unity for immersive analysis.
longDescription: This project involved executing an end-to-end medical imaging pipeline. We started by preprocessing MRI datasets using FSL for image segmentation. Subsequently, we trained a deep learning model using nnU-Net. The final stage involved developing a real-time 3D rendering interface in Unity to allow for immersive analysis of the MRI data.
